% End-to-end pipeline: the extractor (baseline in black, extension additions in orange), the
% training-only proxy loss, and the evaluation path through the speech gate and Gemini.
% The bold tags mark where each research question is answered.
% Generated by Claude Code from the author's specification; replaces the full-page block diagram.
% Extension details follow the code: src/models/bsrnn.py (cue parts enter as 3 extra input channels)
% and src/models/conditioning.py (ECAPA embedding scales the features by 1 + gamma after the per-band norm).
%
% Requires, in the preamble: \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,calc,backgrounds}
\begin{figure}[!htb]
\centering
\definecolor{extcolour}{HTML}{C1440E}
\definecolor{rqcolour}{HTML}{0B6E99}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    font=\scriptsize\sffamily,
    >={Stealth[width=4pt,length=4pt]},
    block/.style={draw, fill=white, rounded corners=1.5pt, align=center, inner sep=2.5pt, minimum height=7mm},
    ext/.style={block, draw=extcolour, text=extcolour, dashed, thick},
    sig/.style={inner sep=1pt, align=center},
    note/.style={font=\scriptsize\sffamily, text=black!60, align=center, inner sep=1pt},
    rq/.style={font=\footnotesize\sffamily\bfseries, text=rqcolour, inner sep=1pt},
    arr/.style={->, thick, black!75},
    extarr/.style={->, thick, extcolour},
    dasharr/.style={->, thick, black!45, dashed},
  ]

  % ---------- extractor ----------------------------------------------------
  \node[sig] (x) at (0.75,0) {mixture\\$x$};
  \node[sig] (e) at (0.75,-1.5) {enrolment\\$e$};

  \node[block, text width=11mm] (stft) at (3.0,0) {STFT};
  \node[block, text width=21mm] (tfmap) at (3.35,-1.5) {TF-Map cue\\ \textcolor{extcolour}{as parts $u_t$, $c_t$, $r_t$}};
  \node[block, text width=19mm] (split) at (5.6,0) {band split,\\ per-band norm};
  \node[draw=extcolour, thick, dashed, circle, inner sep=1pt, text=extcolour] (fuse) at (7.35,0) {$\times$};
  \node[ext, text width=19mm] (ecapa) at (7.35,-1.5) {ECAPA (frozen)};
  \node[block, text width=21mm] (sep) at (9.6,0) {$6\times$ [time LSTM\\ (causal), band LSTM]};
  \node[block, text width=19mm] (est) at (12.0,0) {mask $M$ +\\ residual $R$};
  \node[block, text width=9mm] (istft) at (14.1,0) {iSTFT};
  \node[sig] (out) at (15.45,0) {$\hat{s}$};

  \draw[arr] (x) -- (stft);
  \draw[arr] (stft) -- (split);
  \draw[arr] (stft.south) -- node[note, right] {$|X|$} (stft.south |- tfmap.north);
  \draw[arr] (e) -- (tfmap);
  \draw[arr] (tfmap.east) -| node[note, pos=0.75, right] {cue} (split.south);
  \draw[arr] (split) -- (fuse);
  \draw[arr] (fuse) -- (sep);
  \draw[arr] (sep) -- (est);
  \draw[arr] (est) -- (istft);
  \draw[arr] (istft) -- (out);
  % ECAPA reads the enrolment once per utterance, not per frame
  \draw[extarr] (e.south) -- (e.south |- 0,-2.35) -| (ecapa.south);
  \draw[extarr] (ecapa) -- (fuse);
  % The complex mixture bypasses the network: the mask multiplies into it.
  \draw[arr, black!45] (stft.north) -- ++(0,0.45) -| node[note, pos=0.25, above] {complex mixture $X$} (est.north);

  % Extractor frame, title and RQ3 tag
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
    \draw[black!35, rounded corners=3pt] (2.2,1.2) rectangle (14.85,-2.6);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \node[anchor=south west, inner sep=1pt] (title) at (2.2,1.25) {\footnotesize Extractor (causal, real-time)};
  \node[rq, anchor=west] at (title.east) {\ RQ3};
  \node[note, text=extcolour, anchor=south east] at (14.75,-2.5) {dashed orange: extension only};

  % ---------- training only ------------------------------------------------
  \node[block, text width=21mm, draw=black!45, dashed] (loss) at (12.0,2.35) {proxy loss\\ (training only)};
  \node[sig] (target) at (9.3,2.35) {clean target $s$};
  \draw[dasharr] (target) -- (loss);
  \draw[dasharr] (out.north) |- (loss.east);
  \draw[dasharr] (loss.south) -- node[note, right] {gradient} (12.0,1.2);

  % ---------- evaluation -----------------------------------------------------
  \node[block, text width=17mm] (gate) at (13.85,-3.9) {speech gate\\ (Silero VAD)};
  \node[block, text width=28mm] (gemini) at (10.5,-3.9) {Gemini 3.7 Flash\\ audio in, text out\\ \scriptsize stand-in for Gemini Live};
  \node[block, text width=25mm] (score) at (6.65,-3.9) {score against target\\ and interferer\\ transcripts};
  \node[block, text width=30mm, align=left] (metrics) at (2.35,-3.9) {LCF-WER\enspace all errors\\ ICR\enspace leaked words\\ FR\enspace invented words};
  \node[rq, anchor=south east] at (metrics.north east) {RQ2};

  \draw[arr] (out.south) |- (gate.east);
  \draw[arr] (gate) -- (gemini);
  \draw[arr] (gemini) -- (score);
  \draw[arr] (score) -- (metrics);

  % Conventional measures on the same output, compared with the listener's error
  \node[block, text width=34mm] (conv) at (11.0,-5.55) {SDR, SIR, SAR, DNSMOS,\\ Whisper WER};
  \draw[arr] (15.45,-3.9) -- (15.45,-5.55) -- (conv.east);
  \draw[dasharr] (conv.west) -| (metrics.south);
  \node[note, anchor=south] at (6.0,-5.55) {\textcolor{rqcolour}{\textbf{RQ1}}\enspace do they agree with LCF-WER?};

\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{End-to-end pipeline. Top: the extractor. Orange blocks are the extension's additions: the cue passed as its parts (\autoref{sec:splitting_cue}) and a frozen ECAPA embedding that scales the features (\autoref{sec:speaker_context_embedding}). Gemini cannot be differentiated through, so training uses a proxy loss against the clean target (\autoref{sec:objective}). Bottom: evaluation. The output passes a speech gate, is transcribed by Gemini 3.7 Flash and is scored against both speakers' transcripts (\autoref{sec:metrics}). Bold tags mark where each research question is answered (\ref{ai:diagrams}).}
\label{fig:pipeline}
\end{figure}
